name: DayZ Standalone
author: blu@minopia.de
description: DayZ Standalone dedicated server. BattlEye is controlled by the single DISABLE_BATTLEYE variable: 1 patches the server binary so BattlEye never initialises (no global-ban or VAC kicks, and no BE RCON), 0 runs the stock binary with BattlEye and RCON fully working. Supports both the Release (223350) and Experimental (1042420) dedicated server app IDs, with VPPAdminTools provisioning and server-side chat commands.

installation.script:
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
curl --fail -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

chown -R root:root /mnt
# HOME on the persistent volume: the Steam sentry from a successful Guard login
# (Steam/config/ssfn*) then outlives this throwaway installer container.
export HOME=/mnt/server

# --- Steam Guard / 2FA ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEAM_AUTH holds EITHER a literal 5-character code OR a URL that returns one; the mode is
# inferred from the value. A URL is preferable -- a TOTP is single-use with a ~30 second life, and
# there is an apt install and a steamcmd bootstrap ahead of the login. setup_vpp.sh uses the same
# variable the same way at runtime for workshop downloads.
GUARD_FILE="/mnt/server/.steam_auth"
[[ -z "${STEAM_AUTH}" && -f "${GUARD_FILE}" ]] && STEAM_AUTH="$(tr -d ' \r\n' < "${GUARD_FILE}")"

is_url() { [[ "${1}" =~ ^https?:// ]]; }

mint_2fa_code() {
    local src="${STEAM_AUTH}"
    [[ -z "${src}" ]] && return 0
    if ! is_url "${src}"; then echo "${src}"; return 0; fi
    # ASF wants its IPC secret as a header on newer builds and as ?password= on older ones.
    local ipc_pw=""
    case "${src}" in *password=*) ipc_pw="${src##*password=}"; ipc_pw="${ipc_pw%%&*}" ;; esac
    local response
    response="$(curl --fail -sSL --max-time 15 -H "Authentication: ${ipc_pw}" "${src}" 2>/dev/null)"
    [[ -z "${response}" ]] && response="$(curl --fail -sSL --max-time 15 "${src}" 2>/dev/null)"
    [[ -z "${response}" ]] && { echo "  2FA endpoint returned nothing." >&2; return 0; }
    # ASF's shape first (last match), then a bare body, then any uppercase 5-char token. The
    # first step stops a 5-character uppercase bot name winning over the code.
    local code bare
    code="$(echo "${response}" | grep -oE '"Result"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[A-Za-z0-9]{5}"' \
            | tail -1 | grep -oE '[A-Za-z0-9]{5}"$' | tr -d '"')"
    if [[ -z "${code}" ]]; then
        bare="$(echo "${response}" | tr -d ' \r\n')"
        [[ "${bare}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9]{5}$ ]] && code="${bare}"
    fi
    [[ -z "${code}" ]] && code="$(echo "${response}" | grep -oE '[A-Z0-9]{5}' | head -1)"
    echo "${code}" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]'
}

# Anonymous is valid here: the Experimental server (1042420) needs no account, unlike Release.
for attempt in 1 2; do
    CODE="$(mint_2fa_code)"
    echo "Downloading appid ${STEAMCMD_APPID} (attempt ${attempt})..."
    # Unquoted ${CODE}: steamcmd takes the Guard code as +login's third positional argument, and an
    # empty value must vanish rather than become an empty argument. stdin is /dev/null and the call
    # is time-boxed, or a Guard prompt blocks forever on a tty that does not exist.
    timeout 3600 ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server \
        +login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}" ${CODE} \
        +app_update ${STEAMCMD_APPID} ${STEAMCMD_EXTRA_FLAGS} validate +quit < /dev/null 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log
    # Judged by the app manifest, not steamcmd's exit status, which is non-zero on good runs --
    # and a pipeline's status is tee's anyway, so testing it directly always reports success.
    if [[ -f "/mnt/server/steamapps/appmanifest_${STEAMCMD_APPID}.acf" ]] \
       && ! grep -qiE 'Login Failure|two-factor|Invalid Password|Rate Limit' /tmp/steamcmd.log; then
        break
    fi
    if [[ "${attempt}" == "1" ]]; then
        echo "  Login or download failed."
        # A TOTP only rolls over every 30s, so minting again now returns the same rejected code.
        is_url "${STEAM_AUTH}" && { echo "  Waiting 31s for a new TOTP window..."; sleep 31; }
    else
        echo "FATAL: could not download appid ${STEAMCMD_APPID}. Check the credentials, game"
        echo "  ownership (Release 223350 requires it; Experimental 1042420 does not), and that"
        echo "  STEAM_AUTH is a valid code or a reachable endpoint."
        exit 1
    fi
done

# Consume a stale single-use code; keep a URL, which stays valid.
if [[ -f "${GUARD_FILE}" ]] && ! is_url "$(tr -d ' \r\n' < "${GUARD_FILE}")"; then
    rm -f "${GUARD_FILE}"
    echo "Consumed and removed .steam_auth (single-use)."
fi

# Set up 32 and 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk{32,64}
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

# Download / deliver egg companion scripts (patch_be.pl, setup_vpp.sh, dayz_init_server.c)
# Tracks master, matching the other eggs in this repo: a reinstall always gets the current
# helpers. The trade-off is that an egg exported today may fetch different scripts later; pin
# RAW_REF to a commit SHA if you need a server frozen to one version.
RAW_REF="master"
RAW_BASE="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluscream/pterodactyl-eggs/${RAW_REF}/dayz-standalone"

fetch() {
    # --fail is mandatory: without it curl exits 0 on a 404 and writes the
    # "404: Not Found" HTML/text body straight into the destination file.
    echo "Fetching ${1}..."
    curl --fail -sSL -o "/mnt/server/${1}.tmp" "${RAW_BASE}/${1}" || {
        echo "FATAL: could not download ${1} from ${RAW_BASE}"
        rm -f "/mnt/server/${1}.tmp"
        exit 1
    }
    mv "/mnt/server/${1}.tmp" "/mnt/server/${1}"
}

fetch boot.sh
fetch patch_be.pl
fetch setup_vpp.sh
fetch dayz_init_server.c
chmod +x /mnt/server/boot.sh /mnt/server/patch_be.pl /mnt/server/setup_vpp.sh

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Used for installation and updates. "anonymous" username can be used for server download, but a real account that owns DayZ is required for mod downloads. For security reasons it is recommended that you create a new Steam account just for your dedicated servers. *This info is not visible to the server owner.*

variables.name: [REQUIRED] Steam Password
variables.description: Password for the Steam account above. Stored in the panel database in plain text -- as with every Pterodactyl egg, since the panel has no credential store.

variables.name: Disable Mod Downloads/Updates
variables.description: If the Steam account does not own the base DayZ game, Steam Workshop mod downloads/updates will not work. If so, this setting allows disabling of this feature to avoid errors. (1 ON | 0 OFF)

variables.name: Number of SteamCMD Retry Attempts
variables.description: How many times SteamCMD should retry downloading a server or mod after a recoverable error. (ie. A particularly large mod download times out)

variables.name: [Advanced] Extra Flags for SteamCMD
variables.description: Extra flags appended to every steamcmd app_update call.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Server name shown in the in-game server browser. Written into the server config on every boot.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed to join the server.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Join password. Leave empty for a public server.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Admin/RCON passphrase, shared by serverDZ.cfg passwordAdmin, BattlEye RCON and VPPAdminTools. Leave blank to have setup_vpp.sh generate one once and persist it to .admin_secret; the resolved value is written back into serverDZ.cfg at boot.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Quickly checks for any server or mod updates on startup, and updates if necessary.

variables.name: Modlist File (Exported from DayZ Launcher)
variables.description: Filename for an exported modlist. This file will be parsed for mod installation and loading. Upload your HTML file to the root directory (eg. /home/container/modlist.html). Leave blank to disable loading mods from a modlist.

variables.name: Additional Mods
variables.description: Workshop mod IDs. Defaults to Community Framework (1559212036) + VPPAdminTools (1828439124), which are what ENABLE_VPP_ADMIN=1 requires.

variables.name: Verify Signatures
variables.description: 2 requires every addon to be signed and its .bikey present in keys/ (boot.sh syncs keys out of mod folders automatically). 0 disables checking -- testing only.

variables.name: Enforce Game Version
variables.description: When ON, the server will allow the connection only to clients with same the version as the server.

variables.name: Disable VoN
variables.description: When ON, will disable Voice over Network (voice chat) in the server.

variables.name: VoN Quality
variables.description: Voice over Network codec quality; the higher the better. (Values 0-30)

variables.name: Disable Third Person
variables.description: When ON, will disable third person view while on the server.

variables.name: Disable Crosshair
variables.description: When ON, will disable the crosshair from being visible while on the server.

variables.name: Disable Personal Light
variables.description: When ON, will disable a personal light positioned above all clients during the night time while on the server.

variables.name: Darker Nights
variables.description: When ON, will make nights darker (more accurate nights, but hard to see without a light).

variables.name: Persistent Time
variables.description: The actual server time is saved to storage, so when ON, the next server start will use the saved time value.

variables.name: Time Multiplier
variables.description: This is a time multiplier for in-game time (ie. 12 would move a full 24-hour day in-game 12 times faster, making it last 2 hours "in real life"). (Values: 0-24)

variables.name: Night Multiplier
variables.description: This is an additional multiplier to either speed up or slow down nights in-game. It is multiplied with the "Time Multiplier" variable to get it's final multiplier for night time speed. (Values: 0.1-64.0)

variables.name: [Repair] Make Mod Files Lowercase
variables.description: Every mod that is set to be loaded will have its folder and files changed to lowercase (to prevent errors). It is recommended to enable this for one server boot after copying a mod from a Windows machine to the server, or if mods seem to not be loading.

variables.name: [Repair] Validate Server Files
variables.description: Validates all server files when Automatic Updates is ON. Note: This will significantly increase server startup times, so it is recommended to only enable this when needed.

variables.name: [Advanced] Server-Side Only Mods
variables.description: Mod folders to be used with the "-serverMods" startup option. They only run server-side and are not required by clients if "Verify Signatures" is ON. Any mods in this list that are in "@workshopID" form will also be included in Automatic Updates (if enabled). NO capital letters, spaces, or folders starting with a number! Each folder must be followed with a semicolon (ex. @123456789;@987654321;etc;)

variables.name: [Advanced] Extra Startup Parameters
variables.description: Extra DayZ server parameters. BattlEye is handled by Disable BattlEye, not by -nobe.

variables.name: [Advanced] Server Binary
variables.description: Linux ELF server binary. The runtime image runs the native Linux build; DayZServer_x64.exe is the Windows name and is not used here.

variables.name: [Advanced] DayZ SA Dedicated Server App ID
variables.description: App ID to download. 223350 for Release (requires Steam user), 1042420 for Experimental (anonymous).

variables.name: Allow Client File Patching
variables.description: Allow or disallow clients connecting with the -filePatching startup flag (0 = Disallowed, 1 = Allowed). If clients launch with -filePatching enabled, the server must have this set to 1.

variables.name: Enable VPPAdminTools & CF
variables.description: Automatically downloads, installs, and configures VanillaPlusPlus Admin Tools (Workshop: 1879460278) and Community Framework (CF Workshop: 1559212036), copies server keys, and registers admin permissions.

variables.name: VPP SuperAdmin SteamID64s
variables.description: Comma or space separated SteamID64s to automatically grant SuperAdmin credentials in VPPAdminTools permissions.

variables.name: Steam Query Port
variables.description: Port used by Steam and DayZ SA Launcher to query server info (A2S_INFO). Bohemia default is 2305.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: BattlEye RCON port, written into BEServer_x64.cfg when DISABLE_BATTLEYE=0. Ignored entirely when DISABLE_BATTLEYE=1, since BattlEye never loads and nothing binds it.

variables.name: BattlEye Master Switch (Disable BattlEye)
variables.description: The SOLE decider for BattlEye. 1 = patch the server binary, set battleye=0 and remove BEServer_x64.cfg: no bans, no kicks, no RCON. 0 = restore the stock binary, set battleye=1 and write BEServer_x64.cfg: BattlEye and BE RCON both work. Anything other than an explicit 0 is treated as 1. Nothing else -- not -nobe, not serverDZ.cfg, not the panel's config parser -- influences BattlEye state.

variables.name: Steam Guard Code or 2FA URL
variables.description: Steam Guard 2FA, as EITHER a literal 5-character code OR a URL that returns one -- the mode is inferred from the value, so there is one setting and no precedence rule to remember. A URL is strongly preferred: a literal code is single-use and expires in about 30 seconds, while a URL is re-minted before every login and again after the 31-second retry wait. Any ArchiSteamFarm endpoint works, e.g. https://asf.host/api/bot/<bot>/twoFactorAuthentication/token?password=<ipc>, and both the header and query-string forms of the IPC secret are sent. The file .steam_auth in the server root is honoured too and outlives this variable -- prefer it when the URL embeds a secret, since panel variables are readable by any panel admin. A literal code there is consumed after use; a URL is kept.

variables.name: Install Custom Mission init.c
variables.description: Overwrite the ACTIVE mission's init.c with dayz_init_server.c (sinipelto/dayz-scripts plus the chat commands). OFF by default because it is destructive to a hand-edited mission -- a timestamped backup is taken, but only the original file, not later edits. Enable only on a server whose mission you have not customised.

variables.name: Download Workshop Mods
variables.description: Let setup_vpp.sh download any mod in Client Mods that is not already installed, using a Steam Guard code the runtime image's own downloader cannot supply. Set 0 to skip it entirely -- useful when Steam is rate-limiting or unreachable, since a failed download costs two attempts per boot.
